verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of iTerm2 applying color schemes or themes, and none of a built-in automatic light/dark mode switch. The only light/dark evidence is a user's own Python script that switches themes with the system appearance, which is a user-side workaround built on a developer API. The 24-bit color, Smart Cursor Color/Minimum Contrast and automatic profile-switching items are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching
